title: Chapter 274 Control Skills: The Eternal Magic Skill
content:
Chapter 274 Control Skills: The Eternal Magic Skill

Wang Shuo was not interested in this set of armor blueprints because he already had one.

But other lords were jealous.

"Starting price, 10,000 energy crystals."

"15,000!"

"18,000!"

...

If you want to fight in the future, good standard equipment is indispensable. It can be said that the value of this set of armor blueprints is definitely not low.

Wang Shuo saw that the three people who came with him did not bid.

"Brother Tianba, don't you need this thing?"

"Well, I'm more interested in the following things."

Wang Shuo looked at the beautiful young woman Bu Lanlan and the gentleman Lawrence again. They were very calm.

It seems that they don't lack such things.

In the end, this piece of armor blueprint was sold at a price of 110,000 energy crystals.

Wang Shuo didn't know whether it was expensive or not. After all, as time goes by, there will be more and more energy crystals, and at the same time, there will be more and more good blueprints.

"The second auction item is a set of letter darts."

This kind of thing is most suitable for assassins.

Those who choose lords rarely have this profession.

Therefore, there were few bidders, and it was eventually bought by a lord at a price of 20,000.

Then, a fragment of a treasure map, a set of Xuan-level skills, and...

A large number of things were taken out.

These things were still a little less attractive to Wang Shuo. He only had more than 2 million energy crystals on him, so he had to spend them sparingly.

At this time, the host took out a dead spirit bead.

Wang Shuo looked at it carefully.

Damn, isn't this made by himself?

This is really a big deal.

"The bead in my hand is called the Death Bead. It can effectively absorb the death energy emitted by the undead. It has the same effect as the Death Talisman. It will surely shine in the next undead confrontation. The starting price of 1,000 pieces is 10,000 energy crystals."

"Hey, can you sell them separately?"

"This kind of thing is used for military equipment. A few pieces alone are not very meaningful. If you can form an army that is not afraid of death, then it will be invincible."

The lords underground whispered to each other.

Most of them did not know the horror of the undead army, but they all had a try-it attitude.

"Twelve thousand."

"Fifteen thousand."

"Eighteen thousand."

...

"Thirty thousand."

Finally, it was bought by a lord at a price of thirty thousand. Wang Shuo found that most of the bidders were town lords, and there were very few lords from other villages bidding.

The next item is a skill, "root entanglement".

Wang Shuo naturally likes this single-target control skill very much.

"Ten thousand."

He immediately bid.

He liked it, and so did others.

Others immediately followed suit.

"Twenty thousand."

...

After several rounds of bidding.

Finally, Wang Shuo bought this skill for a hundred thousand.

Then there was another skill, "Abyssal Swamp".

This skill was even more suitable for Wang Shuo.

After spending another sixty thousand energy crystals, Wang Shuo took it.

During this period, Ye Tianba, Lawrence and the other two also gained something.

The last auction item was a rare weapon.

The levels of weapons are divided into ordinary, excellent, gold and rare.

This was the first weapon Wang Shuo had seen that was higher than gold. More importantly, it was a spear weapon - the Blood-Crying Spear.

Wang Shuo's eyes were burning.
